text: {"lessons":["I’ll add to a stock only when its outlook still justifies the position—not simply because I’m holding it or its price has moved.","I’ll set clear reasons to buy, hold, or sell, and reassess them as prices and evidence change rather than letting my average cost dictate the decision.","I’ll limit unnecessary turnover, keep enough diversification and cash, and judge results over time against the overall market—not a few months of account swings."]}
